This uses a local experimental XPU path that dequantizes the 128x128 block-FP8 checkpoint after load and requantizes to per-channel FP8 W8A16 because current XPU kernels do not provide native block-FP8 W8A8 GEMM for this checkpoint. Latency was 25.464 s for one 512-token prompt plus 512 generated tokens, so tokSOut is outputTokens / end-to-end latency and includes prefill overhead. Fixed 1 GiB KV cache per GPU was used to avoid vLLM/XPU automatic KV profiling OOM. TP4 at the same shape was slower at 26.606 s.
